changelog.category: Root Font Sizing (90% Compact UI) & Zero Gap Fix (v1.7.6)
items: Replaced viewport zoom property with root HTML 90% font-size scaling for standard web-compliant compact UI proportioning.
Guaranteed 100% full screen width and 100vh height coverage with zero blank gaps on the right edge or bottom margin.
Maintained permanent right-edge visibility for 3-dot track options buttons across search results and playlists.
Bumped service worker cache version to v113.
